meta.name: claude-mem-install
meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: local worker plus CMEM Pro observer (default), optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. No Cursor required.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为对话机器人装上长期记忆,支持本地或远程两种运行方式
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让 AI 助手记住跨会话的上下文却不知怎么搭记忆服务
copy.tagline_en: Give your chatbot long-term memory, run locally or remotely
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your assistant to recall context across sessions but need help wiring up memory.

howto.what: 为 Grok Bot 安装 claude-mem,默认走 CMEM Pro:在本机启动 worker、按 agent 监听转录,把记忆写进 memory/log 日志,并在任务开始时经 MCP 给出 session_start_context。不需要 Cursor、xAI key 或 Claude CLI。
howto.when: 当你要在 Grok Bot 上安装 claude-mem 时触发:默认是本地 worker + CMEM Pro observer,也可选 host 登录 observer 或远程 cmem.ai。Cursor 不是必需。

say.text: 在 Grok Bot 上装 claude-mem,用默认的 CMEM Pro
用 host 登录当 observer 来装

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem for Grok Bot. Default is a local worker plus CMEM Pro observer: it watches agent transcripts, writes memory logs, and serves session_start_context over MCP at task start. No Cursor, xAI key, or Claude CLI.
howto.when_en: Use when setting up claude-mem on Grok Bot: default local worker plus CMEM Pro observer, optional host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai. Cursor is not required.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem on Grok Bot with the default CMEM Pro path
Install it with the host-login observer
Install it as a remote setup against https://cmem.ai
